source.citation: Sedra & Smith (2014). Microelectronic Circuits, 7th ed., section 17.2, extended here as a loaded capacitor-selection design task.

sim_completed.description: 1 if LTspice AC sweep ran without errors, else 0

selected_cap_uF.description: Smallest capacitor from {0.22, 0.47, 1.0, 2.2} uF that meets both AC specs
selected_cap_uF.T_good_source: LTspice stepped Cval list shows 0.47 uF gives -9.97 dB at 1 kHz and 1.0 uF gives -16.09 dB while keeping 10 Hz gain above -1 dB.

gain_10hz.description: Loaded pass-band gain at 10 Hz for selected_cap_uF, in dB
gain_10hz.T_good_source: Oracle stepped LTspice 26.0.1 run at selected C=1.0 uF measured -0.842 dB at 10 Hz with the 10 kOhm load included.

atten_1khz.description: Loaded attenuation at 1 kHz for selected_cap_uF, in dB
atten_1khz.T_good_source: Oracle stepped LTspice 26.0.1 run at selected C=1.0 uF measured -16.095 dB at 1 kHz.

f_3db.description: Loaded frequency at which |V(out)| drops to 1/sqrt(2) of its 10 Hz value for selected_cap_uF
f_3db.T_good_source: Oracle stepped LTspice 26.0.1 run at selected C=1.0 uF measured 175.64 Hz; the 10 kOhm load shifts the effective resistance from the unloaded textbook value.
